title: Norway Mourns King Harald V as New Monarch Takes the Throne
subtitle: King Haakon VIII promises to serve the nation as citizens gather to pay their respects to his late father.

summary.en: Norway is observing a national period of mourning following the death of King Harald V at age 89. His son, King Haakon VIII, addressed the nation for the first time as monarch on Saturday. The new king praised his father’s dedication and promised to uphold Norway’s democratic values. Thousands of citizens have visited the royal palace to leave flowers and messages of support. Despite the transition, the royal family faces personal challenges as they begin this new chapter.
summary.zh: 挪威在八十九歲的哈拉爾五世國王逝世後，進入全國哀悼期。他的兒子哈康八世國王於週六首次以君主身分對全國發表談話。新國王讚揚了父親的奉獻精神，並承諾維護挪威的民主價值。數千名民眾前往皇宮獻花並留下支持的訊息。儘管面臨政權過渡，王室在開啟新篇章之際，仍需面對個人的挑戰。

paragraphs.en: Norway is currently in a state of national mourning following the death of King Harald V, who passed away on Friday at the age of 89. The late monarch, who served for more than three decades, was widely respected as a symbol of an open and modern society. According to Deutsche Welle (DW), King Harald had been receiving hospital treatment in Oslo since mid-August for hemolytic anemia, a condition that destroys red blood cells and causes extreme tiredness. His health had been declining for some time, which had already forced him to limit his official duties.
paragraphs.zh: 挪威目前正處於全國哀悼狀態，以悼念週五辭世的哈拉爾五世國王（King Harald V），享壽八十九歲。這位已故君主在位超過三十年，被廣泛視為開放與現代社會的象徵。根據德國之聲（Deutsche Welle）報導，哈拉爾國王自八月中旬起便因溶血性貧血在奧斯陸住院治療，這是一種會破壞紅血球並導致極度疲勞的疾病。他的健康狀況早已每況愈下，這也迫使他不得不減少公務。

paragraphs.en: On Saturday, his son and successor, King Haakon VIII, delivered his first televised address to the nation from the royal palace. In an emotional speech, he remembered his father as a "wonderful papa" and a dedicated family man. "Above all, you were a person who remained committed to your values and dedicated to your duties," Haakon stated. The new king also expressed his gratitude to the thousands of citizens who have gathered at the palace to leave flowers, candles, and notes of sympathy. Al Jazeera English reports that Haakon described the sight of the Palace Square filled with tributes as a "powerful and moving experience."
paragraphs.zh: 週六，他的兒子兼繼承人哈康八世國王（King Haakon VIII）從皇宮發表了首次全國電視演說。在感性的演講中，他回憶父親是一位「很棒的爸爸」以及顧家的好男人。哈康表示：「最重要的是，您是一位始終堅守價值觀並致力於職責的人。」這位新任國王也對數千名聚集在皇宮外獻花、點蠟燭並留下慰問信的民眾表達感謝。半島電視台英語頻道（Al Jazeera English）報導，哈康形容看到皇宮廣場上充滿致意物品的景象，是一次「強大且感人的體驗」。

paragraphs.en: King Haakon, who automatically became monarch upon his father’s death, emphasized that he intends to follow his own path while maintaining the principles of Norway’s constitutional monarchy. He reaffirmed his belief in the nation’s system of self-governance and the rule of law, where every person is treated with equal value. To formalize his position, the new king is scheduled to swear an oath in parliament this coming Tuesday, promising to uphold the country’s constitution and laws. While Norway does not hold formal coronations, Haakon may choose to have a traditional consecration ceremony at Trondheim Cathedral in the future.
paragraphs.zh: 哈康國王在父親過世後自動繼位，他強調自己打算在維持挪威君主立憲制原則的同時，走出屬於自己的道路。他重申對國家自治體系與法治的信念，即每個人都應受到平等的對待。為了正式確立其職位，新國王預計將於下週二在國會宣誓，承諾維護國家的憲法與法律。雖然挪威不舉行正式的加冕典禮，但哈康未來可能會選擇在特隆赫姆大教堂（Trondheim Cathedral）舉行傳統的祝聖儀式。

paragraphs.en: As the country prepares for the funeral, the government has declared an official period of national mourning. Churches across Norway are holding memorial services to honor the late king’s memory. Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Store, who visited the palace to view the late king’s casket, noted that Haakon shares his father’s special ability to bring people together. The prime minister’s comments highlight the importance of the monarchy in maintaining national unity during this difficult time of transition.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著全國為葬禮做準備，政府已宣布進入官方的全國哀悼期。挪威各地的教堂正舉行追思禮拜，以紀念這位已故國王。曾前往皇宮瞻仰靈柩的總理史托爾（Jonas Gahr Støre）指出，哈康繼承了父親凝聚人心的特殊能力。總理的評論凸顯了君主制在國家過渡時期維持團結的重要性。

paragraphs.en: Despite the public displays of support, the royal family is navigating a complex period. The family has recently faced significant personal challenges. Queen Mette-Marit, the new queen, has been under public scrutiny due to her past connections with the late American sex offender Jeffrey Epstein. Additionally, her son from a previous relationship was sentenced to four years in prison in June for rape and other serious crimes, a decision he is currently appealing. Furthermore, Queen Mette-Marit has been dealing with her own health issues, having undergone a lung transplant in July to treat a serious lung disease.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管大眾展現了支持，但王室正處於一個複雜的時期。王室成員近期面臨了重大的個人挑戰。新任梅特-瑪麗特王后（Queen Mette-Marit）因過去與已故美國性犯罪者艾普斯坦（Jeffrey Epstein）的關聯而受到公眾檢視。此外，她與前一段關係所生的兒子在六月因強暴及其他嚴重罪行被判處四年徒刑，目前他正提出上訴。不僅如此，梅特-瑪麗特王后本身也飽受健康問題困擾，她才剛在七月接受肺部移植手術，以治療嚴重的肺部疾病。

paragraphs.en: These events add a layer of difficulty to the royal family’s transition as they balance their public duties with private family matters. However, the focus remains on the legacy of King Harald V. He was known for his efforts to lead a modest and tolerant monarchy, and his death marks the end of a significant era in Norwegian history. As the nation prepares for the upcoming funeral, the focus will remain on honoring a leader who represented Norway with what King Haakon called "pride and joy."
paragraphs.zh: 這些事件為王室的過渡期增添了困難，他們必須在公務與私人家庭事務之間取得平衡。然而，焦點依然放在哈拉爾五世留下的遺產上。他以致力於領導一個謙遜且包容的君主制而聞名，他的逝世標誌著挪威歷史上一個重要時代的結束。隨著全國為即將到來的葬禮做準備，焦點將持續放在紀念這位以哈康國王所稱「驕傲與喜悅」代表挪威的領袖身上。

quiz.question: What specifically caused King Harald V to reduce his official responsibilities prior to his passing?

options.A: He was preparing for his son's upcoming coronation.
options.B: He suffered from a medical condition that resulted in severe fatigue.
options.C: He was dealing with the public scrutiny surrounding his daughter-in-law.
options.D: He decided to step down to allow for a peaceful transition of power.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據第一段，國王患有溶血性貧血（hemolytic anemia），這種疾病會破壞紅血球並導致極度疲勞，這迫使他不得不減少公務。選項 A 錯誤，因為文章提到挪威沒有正式的加冕典禮；選項 C 錯誤，因為這是發生在後段提到的家庭醜聞，與國王減少公務的直接原因無關；選項 D 錯誤，文章並未提到國王主動退位，他是因病過世。

quiz.question: Based on the text, what can be inferred about the transition of power in Norway?

options.A: The new king is expected to radically change the constitutional monarchy system.
options.B: The transition is occurring during a time of both public grief and internal family complications.
options.C: The government is concerned that the new king may not be able to maintain national unity.
options.D: The royal family is planning to move away from public life due to recent controversies.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。文章第四段提到國家正處於哀悼與過渡期，而第五段則詳細列舉了新王后 Mette-Marit 面臨的法律與健康挑戰，可推斷王室在處理國家哀悼的同時，內部正面臨嚴峻的個人困境。選項 A 與第三段內容矛盾，新國王表示會維持原則；選項 C 與第四段總理的說法矛盾；選項 D 過度推論，文章並未指出王室要退出公眾生活。

quiz.question: In the fifth paragraph, what does the word 'navigating' mean in the context of the royal family's situation?

options.A: Managing or dealing with a difficult situation.
options.B: Traveling to different locations to address the public.
options.C: Searching for a new direction in their political policies.
options.D: Ignoring the problems to focus on the funeral arrangements.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在此語境中，navigating 用來比喻王室成員正在處理或應對複雜且困難的局面（包含醜聞與健康問題）。選項 B 是該詞的字面意義（航行/導航），在此不適用；選項 C 錯誤，因為文章強調的是應對現有困難，而非尋找新政策；選項 D 錯誤，文章並未提到王室選擇忽視問題，反而指出這些問題增加了轉型的難度。
